note: Shared pixel anchors for all 25 portrait part sheets (72x96, 3:4 bust, front-facing, light from NW). Every part rasterizes against these coordinates — that is the composer contract (fixed appearance dict -> fixed part list, W4-D): parts are pixel-compatible because they are generated from the same anchors, never re-measured.
